id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this sensor for use in lambdas.

*See also: [Duty Cycle Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/duty_cycle#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin to observe for the duty cycle.

*See also: [Duty Cycle Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/duty_cycle#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [Duty Cycle Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/duty_cycle#configuration-variables)*
